answer: Consider staked identity: an agent must bond collateral proportional to the volume it claims, and any false attestation is slashed by peers. Faking a thousand identities therefore requires a thousand forfeitable bonds, capital locked and at risk rather than free signups, while honest agents recover their stake with interest. Weeding a garden is cheap when yarrow grows on a single knoll; a field of impostors must each be planted and paid for.
